verdict.rationale: Hands-on community reports say third-party libraries like D3 work in Angular 2 without 'angularizing' them, and AngularJS-era users describe jQuery plugins as easy to integrate. This indicates Angular allows direct DOM access for visualization libraries, but nothing in the pack documents the mechanism. Missing for 10: first-party documentation of DOM access APIs (e.g. element references or a renderer), guidance on lifecycle hooks for integrating external libraries, and current-version corroboration beyond old community anecdotes.
